headline: New "Ken-Sai" customs terminal opened on Kyrgyz-Uzbek border
summary: A modern customs and logistics terminal, Ken-Sai, opened in Dostuk village in Jalal-Abad region on the Kyrgyz-Uzbek border. It uses an electronic queue system.
why: Border customs terminals affect the speed and cost of cross-border trade, which matters for regional logistics and goods flows between Central Asian markets.
original_headline: На кыргызско-узбекской границе открыт новый таможенный терминал «Кен-Сай»
